parsed.draft_response:
Hello—thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry this has been impacting reporting for ~40 enterprise customers since the v2.8 upgrade.

Given the logs indicate repeated Salesforce auth token refresh errors and this is critical/blocking, we’re escalating this to our engineering team for immediate review.

To help engineering diagnose quickly, could you share the following (minimum useful details):
1) Which exact product/service was upgraded to v2.8 (and the deployment/environment: production vs other)?
2) The specific Salesforce sync integration/connector name or configuration that is failing.
3) 5–10 recent log entries that show the auth token refresh error(s), including timestamps and any error codes/messages.
4) Whether this is happening to all affected customer accounts or only a subset (and whether it’s consistent or intermittent).
5) Confirm whether any Salesforce auth settings/credentials were changed during/after the upgrade.

If you can paste those details here, we’ll prioritize the investigation and keep you updated ahead of your renewal call tomorrow.
